about: Default clip set, by Mixamo file hash in the jasongzy/Mixamo mirror (which names nothing). Forward locomotion was chosen by blender/scan_locomotion.py, which graded all 2,147 short clips on what a character controller needs: the body faces the way it travels, the path is straight, the source feet do not slip, and the clip closes as a cycle. The rest of the set - strafes, backpedals, turns in place, crouch, sprint, fall and landing - was found by blender/scan_moves.py (how far the body turns, how low the hips go, how long both feet are off the ground), and every finalist was retargeted onto a finished character and judged on front and side contact sheets: scores do not rule out a boxing guard, a zombie reach or a sitting crouch, and several top-scoring candidates were exactly that. Options per clip: travel_deg (the direction it travels, from forward, counter-clockwise from above - strafes and backpedals are planted along it rather than turned to face it), heading 'start' (a turn begins facing forward), mirror (read left for right: the right turn is the left turn mirrored, so the two match), ground false (a fall loop is never planted). Replace any entry with your own Mixamo download to change the character's moves.
